Position-Wise Acceptance on Long 7B Generations (pruned: It is a low-novelty replication of src_a49ee28d that likely confirms a flat acceptance curve. It also needs custom per-token logging, and its interest score is the lowest (0.6).)

Lossless vs Relaxed Acceptance Tradeoff (pruned: src_50a04cdb already covers training-free relaxed acceptance, and the PyTorch prototype is the least feasible (0.65) with noisy quality metrics at about 200 prompts.)

Adaptive Draft Length Controller in llama.cpp (pruned: Its feasibility is only 0.6 because the C++ patch to llama.cpp could use up the four weekends. The area is crowded (576 recent matches, src_d18898d6, src_ce79f5a8), and the gain over the best fixed draft length may be small.)

4090 Draft-Model Sweep for a 7B (pruned: A pure measurement sweep that overlaps heavily with src_1c50a8d8 in a crowded area; a small draft-size comparison can be folded into the kept comparison study instead.)

Build Speculative Decoding From Scratch in PyTorch (pruned: A learning build with low novelty (0.3) whose HF eager-mode overhead and KV-cache rollback risks may hide any speedup, so it does little to make the 7B faster within four weekends.)

Tiny Draft vs No-Draft N-gram Lookup (pruned: The round-2 direction dir_1dd6374b covers the same draft vs n-gram comparison and adds harness references, paired-median measurement and a probe-based chooser, so this version is superseded.)

Visual Explainer: When Does Drafting Pay Off? (pruned: The round-2 direction dir_b33513ef narrows and replaces it with an explicit schema and a no-patch fallback for per-token logging, so keeping both would duplicate work.)
